documents.title: Vulnify Priority Scoring Policy Specification v1.0.0
documents.content:
Vulnify Deterministic Priority Scoring Rules (Policy v1.0.0):

Rule 1 (Highest):
- Finding must have Advisory Severity: CRITICAL
- Version Match Status: affected
- Graph Path Status: path_found (confirmed reachability)
- Fixed Version: Available

Rule 2 (High):
- Advisory Severity: HIGH with confirmed graph path, OR
- Advisory Severity: CRITICAL with unconfirmed/no graph path.

Rule 3 (Medium):
- Advisory Severity: MEDIUM with confirmed graph path, OR
- Advisory Severity: HIGH with unconfirmed/no graph path, OR
- Advisory Severity: UNKNOWN (missing signals are evaluated with caution as Medium, never Low or zero risk).

Rule 4 (Low):
- Advisory Severity: LOW with confirmed graph path, OR
- Advisory Severity: MEDIUM with unconfirmed/no graph path.

Deterministic Tie-Breaker Precedence Order:
1. Priority Band (Highest > High > Medium > Low > Unknown)
2. Advisory Severity (CRITICAL > HIGH > MEDIUM > LOW > UNKNOWN)
3. Graph Path Status (path_found > no_path > unanalyzed)
4. Shortest Path Depth (Ascending: 1 hop precedes 2 hops)
5. Actionable Fix Available (True precedes False)
6. Advisory ID Alphanumeric Ascending Sort
